query:
SELECT id                        AS "id!",
                       COALESCE(createat, 0)     AS "createat!",
                       COALESCE(userid, '')      AS "userid!",
                       COALESCE(action, '')      AS "action!",
                       COALESCE(extrainfo, '')   AS "extrainfo!",
                       COALESCE(ipaddress, '')   AS "ipaddress!",
                       COALESCE(sessionid, '')   AS "sessionid!"
                  FROM audits
                 ORDER BY createat DESC
                 LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2
